items.title: Active Attacks Exploit Gladinet's Hard-Coded Keys for Unauthorized Access and Code Execution
items.description: Huntress is warning of a new actively exploited vulnerability in Gladinet's CentreStack and Triofox products stemming from the use of hard-coded cryptographic keys that have affected nine organizations so far.
